brief:
European political leaders are stepping up military preparations, according to Middle East Eye, amid growing labor organizing against weapons production and defense spending. The preparations coincide with increased Western involvement in Middle Eastern conflicts and have sparked workplace disputes over military contracts and wage conditions.

Workers across Europe are mobilizing to challenge defense industry expansion and military budget allocations, framing the dispute as part of broader labor struggles over employment and compensation.

title: European leaders prepare for war as workers mobilize against it
